validated_results.title: Circulating 25-hydroxyvitamin D, vitamin D binding protein and risk of advanced and lethal prostate cancer.
validated_results.reason: This prospective nested case-control study evaluated prediagnostic circulating 25-hydroxyvitamin D levels and the risk of advanced prostate cancer.

cases.excerpt: OR (95% CI) from conditional logistic models conditioned on matching factors and adjusted for family history of prostate cancer, body mass index (<25.0, 25.0–29.9, ≥30.0 kg/m 2 ), vigorous physical activity (0, 0.1–5.9, 6.0–12.9, 13.0–25.9, ≥26.0 metabolic equivalent-h/week), and smoking status (never, past, current). Cutpoints chosen based on median values in controls: 56 cases and 46 controls with low total 25(OH)D levels and low VDBP levels; 42 cases and 31 controls with low total 25(OH)D levels and high VDBP levels; 32 cases and 31 controls with high total 25(OH)D levels and low VDBP levels; 25 cases and 47 controls with high total 25(OH)D levels and high VDBP levels.
cases.location: Table 2; cases derived from reported group counts 95 + 13 + 47 = 155

effect_size.excerpt: Higher total 25(OH)D levels were associated with lower risk of advanced prostate cancer ( Table 2 ). Compared to those in the bottom quartile of 25(OH)D, men in the top quartile had a multivariable-adjusted OR of 0.50 (95% CI, 0.24–1.03, p trend = 0.02).

confidence_interval.excerpt: Compared to those in the bottom quartile of 25(OH)D, men in the top quartile had a multivariable-adjusted OR of 0.50 (95% CI, 0.24–1.03, p trend = 0.02).

p_value.excerpt: Compared to those in the bottom quartile of 25(OH)D, men in the top quartile had a multivariable-adjusted OR of 0.50 (95% CI, 0.24–1.03, p trend = 0.02).

comparison.excerpt: Biomarkers were categorized into quartiles based on the levels in controls, and we tested for a linear trend across quartiles using an ordinal variable.

design.excerpt: In a prospective case-control study of 156 pairs of advanced prostate cancer cases and controls, we directly measured prediagnostic circulating 25(OH)D and VDBP and calculated bioavailable 25(OH)D using a validated formula.

timing.excerpt: Between 1993 and 2004, 164 men were diagnosed with advanced prostate cancer after providing blood samples.

continent.excerpt: The Health Professionals Follow-Up Study is a prospective cohort that began in 1986 when 51,529 US male health professionals aged 40 to 75 years responded to a questionnaire about health-related behaviors and medical history.

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Plasma 25(OH)D was measured by a radioimmunosorbent assay in the laboratory of Dr. Bruce Hollis (The Medical University of South Carolina, Charleston, SC)
exposure_measurement.location: Methods, Measurement of total 25(OH)D, VDBP, and albumin, paragraph 1
